SELECT p.* FROM USER_PAYMENT_HISTORY p LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.user_idx = p.user_idx WHERE p.payment_type = 'CHARGE' AND p.payment_status = 'COMPLETED'
AND (u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.user_email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.order_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.toss_order_id = #{keyword} OR p.payment_idx = #{keyword})
ORDER BY p.paid_at DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT * FROM USER_PAYMENT_HISTORY WHERE payment_idx = #{paymentIdx} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_PAYMENT_HISTORY SET payment_status = 'REFUNDED', cancelled_at = NOW() WHERE payment_idx = #{paymentIdx} AND payment_status = 'COMPLETED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_WALLET_HISTORY (user_idx, asset_type, change_type, amount, balance_after, related_payment_idx, detail_message, actor_user_idx) VALUES (#{userIdx}, 'CASH', 'REFUND', #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{relatedPaymentIdx}, #{detailMessage}, #{actorUserIdx})

INSERT INTO WALLET_REFUND_LOG (payment_idx, user_idx, refund_amount, refund_reason, toss_cancel_status, refunded_by_user_idx) VALUES (#{paymentIdx}, #{userIdx}, #{refundAmount}, #{refundReason}, #{tossCancelStatus}, #{refundedByUserIdx})
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, u.nickname AS user_nickname, a.nickname AS admin_nickname, p.order_name FROM WALLET_REFUND_LOG r LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.user_idx = r.user_idx LEFT JOIN USERS a ON a.user_idx = r.refunded_by_user_idx LEFT JOIN USER_PAYMENT_HISTORY p ON p.payment_idx = r.payment_idx ORDER BY r.refunded_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
